reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses He bubble hardening and defect recombination in a different HEA, E2 describes strain localization and phase-boundary-mediated deformation in MPEAs, and E3 reports temperature-dependent strength and deformation modes in CoNiCrFeMn, none of which provide evidence for lattice distortion broadening dislocation cores or reducing stress concentrations in WTaTiVZr.
premises: Severe lattice distortion in HEAs broadens dislocation cores
Broader dislocation cores reduce stress concentration at dislocation tips
Reduced stress concentration facilitates gradual, homogeneous dislocation glide
Gradual glide delays crack initiation and enhances plastic strain and toughness
